iconParams.prompt: Create a polished game UI ICON ATLAS for a children's ocean-and-stars learning website. Exactly SIX distinct standalone pictograms in a strict 3 columns by 2 rows grid of equal square cells, no gutters, each icon centered inside its own cell, occupies 65% of cell, all identical scale. Uniform solid deep teal background #123e51 across entire canvas. Style: delightful dimensional storybook game icons, softly sculpted sea-glass turquoise, creamy pearl white, warm gold highlights, restrained luminous edges, clear bold readable silhouettes at 64 pixels. NO text, NO letters, NO labels, NO button frames, NO borders, NO specific animal mascot, NO fox or dog character. Top row left to right: 1 PETTING: a friendly rounded human hand gently stroking a small golden heart with two soft motion curves; 2 FEEDING: a chunky delicious golden star-shaped biscuit with chocolate chips and a small crumb; 3 STAR BALL: glossy turquoise toy ball with one unmistakable golden five-point star. Bottom row left to right: 4 HIGH FIVE: two friendly rounded hands meeting palm to palm at a gold sparkle, distinct from petting; 5 BUBBLES: a turquoise bubble wand with three iridescent soap bubbles floating above; 6 REST: a cozy pearl pillow nestled under a golden crescent moon with two tiny calm stars. Consistent perspective and lighting for all six. High-quality professionally art-directed game interface assets, universally usable by any character.
